description: Open a compact image picker as a supporting workflow for email creation. Opening does not upload anything; the user chooses an image and explicitly submits it through upload_image_asset. Requires an explicit companyId. Clients without MCP Apps can use upload_image_asset directly.

companyId.description: Pinned target company ID from get_account.

name: open_image_upload

outputSchema.description: Structured content returned by the `open_image_upload` MCP tool.

items.description: Fallback array wrapper used only when a tool returns a bare array.

message.description: Human-readable status, confirmation, or next-step message.

value.description: Fallback object wrapper used only when a tool returns a non-object value.

warnings.description: Non-fatal cautions about content, permissions, or follow-up actions.
